Activate sustained formalization of Edition 03 in /Documents/smooth-poincare-4d. Use GPT-6.2 Astra (gpt-6.2-astra) at ultra as lead. Read AGENTS.md, formalization/FORMALIZATION_SETUP_WORKFLOW.md, the Edition 03 overview, plan and baseline, the program and route registers, and formalization/investigations/continuation-notes/AFTER_PARALLEL_ROUTE_SETUP_20261125.md. Compare the current master TeX and its inputs, the updated paper plans, blueprint, live Lean sources and pinned dependencies with the recorded revisions.

Begin with VAR-E01 on actual admissible repairs, CUT-E02 on both full sides, VAR-E05 on the physical chiral quantiles and FOT-E36 on the signed principal curvatures. HT-E01 and the scalar VAR-E06 can proceed independently. Follow useful results into the marked splice, positive path, local replacement, shell extraction, joint repair, Ricci windows, immersion geometry or Morse and handle arguments as the evidence warrants.

I authorize broad research within this program. You may change proof order, try different routes, revise representations, consult primary sources, open or rescope B/E tasks and create gpt-6.2-sol helpers at ultra for independent bounded proofs and reviews. Give each helper a frozen statement, versioned sources, disjoint output files, an acceptance test and a failure condition. Integrate the returns as lead and continue through useful dependencies without seeking routine confirmation.

Use the actual geometric witness and retain its normalization, regularity, marking, raw masses and residuals. For a height argument, distinguish the count, the selected diagram and geometric cancellation. Through the public import, run lake build, #check and #print axioms. Rebuild the blueprint, update the sole owning registers and record what is still a hypothesis. Finish with an assessed milestone and a concrete dated continuation.

I’ll check the Edition 03 baseline against the working tree, then assign bounded proofs with explicit acceptance tests. I’ll verify the integrated results through the public Lean import and check that the blueprint states their geometric hypotheses accurately.

The master manuscript changed after the Edition 03 baseline. The repair and curvature formulas we froze still match their source passages. I also found a Gauss-equation theorem in the pinned geometry library, which gives us a way to connect the principal-curvature calculation to the Levi-Civita curvature of an actual induced metric.

Lean has checked the two-sided cut inequality with the surcharge attached to the surviving cap, along with the finite repair estimate and the sharp signed-curvature inequalities. I’m now checking how those results compose on one metric, including whether its physical chiral measure accounts for the entire unrepaired exterior.

At the immersed threshold \(64\pi^2/9\), the checked energy split now forces equality on the entire nonempty open middle-signature locus. This isolates the next geometric step: exclude that open equality case by Codazzi. The indexed Gauss identity and the smooth handle-count floor remain inputs to this conclusion.

The physical quantiles now come from the selected metric’s own curvature measure. Lean proves that every intrinsic distance sphere has zero volume, so the quantile radii need no separate existence assumption. The repair estimate also reaches the inclusive threshold: it selects a particular positive repaired metric when the measured costs and full uncovered mass satisfy the bound.

The public build passed. At the immersed endpoint, Lean now checks the rank-two Codazzi calculation and the contradiction with mixed Gauss curvature \(-k^2\). The remaining step is local and geometric: derive the projected identities and curvature commutation for the smooth shape operator on the same saturated neighborhood.

All six Edition 03 opening targets now have Lean proofs. The formalization reaches two geometric conclusions on the actual witnesses.

- **Physical minimizing sequence.** Given positive subcritical entry, same-energy Yamabe representatives, a positive fixed-type infimum and a full-curvature budget, Lean selects quantiles on one volume-one minimizing sequence. In the separated case it retains the attaining inner ball, the entire median exterior and an intervening distance shell with arbitrarily small full curvature. Constructing a whole oriented splice chart on that shell remains open.
- **Repairs and cuts.** The two-sided theorem tracks both raw masses, the surviving cap’s cost and its marking. For \(N\) actual positive repairs of a source with energy \(e\), uncovered mass \(r\) and total cost \(\Gamma\), the condition \(r+\Gamma+(N-1)(e-T)\le T\) selects a particular repair of energy at most \(T\), including equality.
- **Immersed endpoint and heights.** At \(E_+\le64\pi^2/9\), the indexed Gauss identity and handle-count floor force spectrum \((-a,-a,a,a)\) on a nonempty open middle locus. Lean checks the projected Codazzi calculation and the mixed Gauss contradiction. Realizing the differential identities on that neighborhood remains open. Below \(8\pi^2\), the conditional height theorem selects a regular direction with two middle critical points. Its attaching diagram and geometric cancellation still require proof.

The full `lake build` passed. All **81 Edition 03 public declarations** and **213 blueprint-linked declarations** passed type and axiom checks using only standard Lean axioms. The PDF and web blueprint were rebuilt, and the owning registers record the remaining hypotheses. No new smooth type was recognized. The exact conversation transcript was unavailable for capture.

Resume sustained Edition 03 formalization in smooth-poincare-4d. Use the author-selected GPT-6.2 Astra/ultra lead and bounded gpt-6.2-sol/ultra helpers. Read AGENTS.md, the formalization workflow, this dated continuation, the latest assessed integration, the owning registers and the updated master manuscript and plans. Verify the current working inputs and toolchain. Start with the pinned public proofs of physical quantile selection, actual measured repairs and two-sided nonsplitting, positive path and fixed-chart defect, and the principal-frame and height results. Pursue the actual marked shell or common-chart interpolation, or the Codazzi exclusion of open equality and actual indexed Gauss identity, in parallel. Continue along diffuse repair, fixed-type alternatives, Ricci windows or diagram-specific surgery when a usable witness is supplied. Keep the threshold endpoints, all costs and residuals, geometry and orientation of the same metric, immersion or minimizing sequence explicit. Give disjoint bounded execution and review packets with frozen targets and versions. Proceed through useful alternatives without routine confirmation. Build the public Lean import, check exact types and axioms, rebuild PDF and web blueprint, update the owning registers, and finish at an assessed milestone with a dated handoff.
I’ll compare the current manuscript, Lean sources and dependency pins with the last assessed milestone, then use that comparison to assign the shell, interpolation and immersion proofs in parallel.

The revised cut theorem includes the endpoint \(E_{\rm left}+E_{\rm right}=2T\). I’m updating the marked reassembly proof to use recognition at \(E=T\), including the tie where both caps have energy \(T\). On the immersed route, the normal projection of the curvature identity now gives Codazzi for the actual chart differential.

The shell proof now places the charged regions on opposite sides of a sphere in the supplied annular chart. On the immersed route, both normal heights have a verified index-two critical point at a \((2,2)\) principal frame. I’m connecting the local Codazzi and curvature results on one chart, and checking which hypotheses still stand between the height calculation and the global indexed identity.

Lean now derives the smooth shape operator from the immersion and its chart metric. It also computes the local Gauss Jacobian as \(\lvert k_1k_2k_3k_4\rvert\). I’m checking the transition between neighboring principal frames, including reversal of the normal, so the open-equality argument can use the manuscript’s pointwise hypotheses.

The open-equality proof has passed Lean. It starts with arbitrary pointwise principal frames on a nonempty open set and derives the contradiction on the actual immersion. The height proof now identifies the nondegenerate index-two critical set with the two normal fibers over the middle locus. I’m checking the strict energy conclusion through the public import and rebuilding the blueprint.

A manuscript revision arrived during verification. At the intrinsic endpoint \(I=4\pi^2\), it gives a finite-disk capture argument and a new lower bound on collar cost. I’m adding checks for what follows from those measured witnesses and recording which parts of the disk-extraction and Ricci arguments still depend on the paper.

**Edition 03 now excludes open equality on the actual immersion.** Lean proves that a smooth isometric hypersurface \(M^4\to\mathbb R^5\) cannot have signed principal curvatures \((-a,-a,a,a)\), with \(a>0\), throughout a nonempty open set. The principal frames may be chosen independently at every point. The proof derives Codazzi for the induced metric and obtains a contradiction from the mixed Gauss curvature \(-a^2\). [Lean proof](sandbox:/Users/ebbaker/Documents/smooth-poincare-4d/formalization/SmoothPoincare/Immersions/GeometricOpenEquality.lean)

For heights, Lean identifies the actual nondegenerate index-two critical points over both antipodal normal fibers. With the stated measure and regularity hypotheses and an almost-sure floor of two for that count, it proves \(E_+(g)>64\pi^2/9\). Constructing the measured Gauss atlas and proving the count floor remain open. A selected handle diagram and its geometric cancellation still require separate arguments.

For marked cuts, the proof charges the actual inner ball and full exterior to opposite sides. It covers two positive caps whose energies are both exactly \(4\pi^2\). The chart interpolation estimate is checked. Constructing that chart on the minimizing sequence and transferring positivity to both caps remain open.

The pinned `lake build` passed. Public type and axiom checks covered 257 Edition 03 declarations and all 259 declarations referenced by the blueprint, using only standard Lean axioms. The [25-page PDF](sandbox:/Users/ebbaker/Documents/smooth-poincare-4d/formalization/blueprint/print/print.pdf) and [web blueprint](sandbox:/Users/ebbaker/Documents/smooth-poincare-4d/formalization/blueprint/web/sec-parallel-investigations.html) were rebuilt.

The [assessed milestone](sandbox:/Users/ebbaker/Documents/smooth-poincare-4d/formalization/investigations/research-progress/handoffs/ED03_CHART_GEOMETRY_20261125.md) records the endpoint costs, residuals and remaining hypotheses. The [November 25 continuation](sandbox:/Users/ebbaker/Documents/smooth-poincare-4d/formalization/investigations/continuation-notes/AFTER_OPEN_EQUALITY_AND_MARKED_SHELL_20261125.md) starts with the spherical area identity and the marked-shell construction. The chat recorder had no exact source for this thread.
